title.zh-TW: 首次購買滿 NT$899，現折 NT$100
title.en: NT$100 off a first purchase of NT$899 or more

text.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0R5，訂單現折 NT$100；限首次購買。取自平台分享文案與邀請頁；實際內容、金額與期限以官方公告為準。
text.en: Enter promo code MGMCKQ0R5 at checkout for NT$100 off; first purchase only. From the share text and invite page; official terms prevail.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（會前往 Norns 的邀請頁）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (it leads to the Norns invitation page).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示登入或註冊 Norns 會員。
steps.en: Log in or register as a Norns member as the page asks.

steps.zh-TW: 選購商品，讓首次購買的訂單金額達 NT$899 以上。
steps.en: Shop so that your first purchase order reaches NT$899 or more.

steps.zh-TW: 結帳時輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0R5（已包含在連結中；若結帳頁沒有自動帶入，請手動輸入），訂單即現折 NT$100。
steps.en: At checkout, enter promo code MGMCKQ0R5 (already in the link; if it is not filled in, type it in) for NT$100 off the order.

intro.zh-TW: Norns 首次購買訂單滿 NT$899，結帳輸入優惠碼 MGMCKQ0R5，訂單現折 NT$100。
intro.en: Norns online shop: on a first purchase of NT$899 or more, enter promo code MGMCKQ0R5 at checkout for NT$100 off.

description.zh-TW:
Norns 是台灣的卡通雜貨與禮品品牌，並經營線上商店。優惠碼 MGMCKQ0R5 已包含在連結中；依邀請頁，好友限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$899（含）以上，訂單現折 NT$100。

活動期間為 2026-02-01 至 2026-12-31；首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。實際內容以官方公告為準。
description.en:
Norns is a Taiwanese brand and online shop for cartoon-themed goods and gifts. The promo code MGMCKQ0R5 is already part of the referral link on this page. According to the invitation page, an invited friend can use the promo code only on a first purchase, and an order of NT$899 or more gets NT$100 off.

The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-02-01 to 2026-12-31, and if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders no longer get the offer. Actual terms, amounts and deadlines follow Norns’s official announcements.

notes.zh-TW: 優惠碼 MGMCKQ0R5 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣（含大小寫），Q 之後是數字 0，不是字母 O。折扣限首次購買、訂單消費達 NT$899（含）以上；依邀請頁，首張訂單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠，活動期間為 2026-02-01 至 2026-12-31。本站沒有測試結帳時優惠碼是否被接受。
notes.en: Promo code MGMCKQ0R5 is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization (after the Q is the digit zero, not the letter O). The discount applies to a first purchase on an order of NT$899 or more; per the invitation page, if the first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer, and the campaign period is 2026-02-01 to 2026-12-31. This site did not test whether the code is accepted at checkout.

q.zh-TW: MGMCKQ0R5 這組優惠碼在 Norns 怎麼使用？
q.en: How do I use promo code MGMCKQ0R5 at Norns?

a.zh-TW: 依邀請頁，限首次購買，訂單消費達 NT$899（含）以上，結帳時使用優惠碼 MGMCKQ0R5，訂單現折 NT$100。本頁連結已包含這組優惠碼；若結帳時需要輸入，請依原樣（含大小寫）輸入。
a.en: According to the invitation page, on a first purchase only, an order of NT$899 or more gets NT$100 off when you use promo code MGMCKQ0R5 at checkout. The code is already part of the link on this page; if you need to type it in, enter it exactly as shown, including capitalization.

q.zh-TW: 這個折扣是給誰的？有活動期限嗎？
q.en: Who gets the discount, and is there a deadline?

a.zh-TW: 折扣給被邀請的好友，也就是使用這組優惠碼的人，限首次購買；首單若有取消或退貨，之後再下單沒有這項優惠。邀請頁顯示的活動期間是 2026-02-01 至 2026-12-31，實際條件以官方公告為準。
a.en: The discount is for the invited friend who uses the promo code, and only on a first purchase; if that first order is cancelled or returned, later orders get no offer. The invitation page shows a campaign period of 2026-02-01 to 2026-12-31, and actual terms follow the official announcements.
